verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [Distrito,] esp. Galiléia no norte da Palestina.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) [ District,] esp. Galilee in Northern Palestine.
notas_originais: Shebi. IX, 2 ג' העליון Upper Galilee, ג' התחתון Lower Galilee. Sot. IX, 15 (49 b) הַגָּ'. Keth. 9 b; a. fr. [ג' בגוים, Snh. 94 b, v. גְּלִילָה.]
Targ. Ezek. XLVII, 8.— Pl. גְּלִילִין, גְּלִילֵי. Targ. Josh. XXII, 10; a. e.

Ib. XX, 7; a. e.—Sabb. 47 a; 78 a בג' שנו it refers only to Galilee.—Tosef. Snh. II, 5; Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56 c top, a. e. ג' עילאה Upper Galilee, ג' תיתאה (ארעיתא) Lower G.; Snh. 11 b גלילאה (corr. acc.).—Erub. 53 b בר ג' a Galilean.
, v. גָּלוֹלָא
Erub. 53 b ג' שוטה (Ms. M. גלילא) foolish Galilean, v. אִימַּר.—Snh. 113 a ההוא ג' a certain Galilean; Sabb. 88 a. Ḥull. 27 b; a. e.— Pl. גְּלִילָאֵי. Y. B. Bath. VI, 15 c top.
Snh. 94 b (play on גליל הגוים, Is. VIII, 23) אני עוש' אותו ג' בגוים Ms. M. (ed. אעשה לו גליל) I will make him (Sennaherib) contemptible among the nations; Yalk. II Kings 237.

Yad. IV, 8 צדוקי ג' Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. only צדוקי) a Galilean Sadducee (heretic).—ר' יוסי הג' R. José the Galilean. Pes. 28 a; a. v. fr., v. יוֹסֵי.—* Pl. גְּלִילִים, גְּלִילִין. Kel. II, 2 הפכים הג' Galilean flasks; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. II, 2 הפכין והג' (read הפכין הג'); ib. 9. [Cmp., however, גָּלָל.]
Sabb. 47 b מטה גליל' Ms. M. (ed. גללני', Ar. גיליתא) folding couch, cot

Targ. O. Gen. XXV, 25 ed. כִּגְלִים (ed. Berl. כָּכְלָן, v. כִּילַן, Var. כִּגְלָם). Targ. II Esth. VIII, 15.—Sabb. 77 b it is called g’lima, שנעשה בו כגוֹלֶם ed. (Ms. M. שנעשית כגו') because one looks in it like a shapeless (armless) body (Ms. M. it is rolled up like a lump). Snh. 102 b שיפולי ג' trail of the cloak; a. fr.— Pl. גְּלִימֵי. Ib. 110 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גְּלַם 2); altura, colina— Pl. גְּלִימָתָא, גַּלְמָתָא.; vale.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. I, II Num. XXIII, 9; Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 26 גּוֹלַמְתָא (read גּוֹלְמָ'). Targ. Y. II ib. 11 sq. גּוֹלְמָתֵיה his hills. Targ. Ps. LXXII, 3 גַּלְמָ'.

Targ. Job XXXIX, 21. Targ. Josh. XVIII, 28 Var. (ed. Lag. I, p. VIII 30 גְּלִימַת).— Pl. גְּלִימָתָא, גַּלְמָתָא. Targ. Job XXXIX, 10. Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 19.—גְּלִימִין. Pesik. B’shall. p. 93 a ומחית ליה ג' (Ar. גַּלְמָן) and carried him down the valleys.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (γαλήνη) calma, quietude do vento e das ondas.
definicoes_originais: (γαλήνη) calm, stillness of wind and wave.
notas_originais: Y. Yeb. XV, 15 d top אם (היה) הים ג' וכ' if there was a calm sea, and you looked around and there was none &c.; Y. Erub. IV, 21 d bot. גלנו ed. Krot. (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. próximo w.) moldar (da escrita), impressionar, poesia.
definicoes_originais: (v. next w.) shaping (of writing), impress, poetry.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. XVI, 1 ג' תריצא a well-arranged poetry (h. text מכתם). Ib. CXIX, 130 גְּלִיף דבריך the impress of thy words (h. text פֵּתַח).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גָּלַף) modelagem, formação (da fala, cmp. גזם, גּוּזְמָא).
definicoes_originais: (גָּלַף) shaping, formation (of speech, cmp. גזם, גּוּזְמָא).
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 33 גְּלִיפַת שפתים eloquence (ref. to Is. LVII, 19).
Pesik. R. s. 20 (defined מְגַלֶּה טעמי צור revealing the reasons of the Creator); Yalk. R’ubeni, Mishpatim end ג' המכונה רזיאל G. surnamed Raziël.
Sot. VIII, 1 בנצחונו של ג' relying on the strength of G. Ib. 42 b ג̇ל̇י̇ת … בג̇יל̇וי̇ פנים וכ' he is named G., because he stood before the Lord with barefacedness (defiance). Lev. R. s. 5; a. fr.
, v. גַּלְבִּין

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); rolar, desdobrar, dobrar.; (v. Gen. XXIX, 3) rolar (os ombros), desconsiderar.; para ser enrolado, dobrado.
definicoes_originais: (v. Gen. XXIX, 3) to roll off (one’s shoulders), disregard.
notas_originais: Meg. 32 a he opens (the scroll), sees the place (to read from), גּוֹלֵל ומברך rolls it up again and says the benediction. Ib. הגּוֹלֵל ס"ת וכ' he who rolls the scrolls up (preparing the place to read from). B. Mets. II, 8 (29 b) גוֹלְלָן he must roll the scrolls over (for the purpose of airing); a. fr.
Gen. R. s. 21 (play on גללו, Job XX, 7) על שג' מצוה וכ' because he disregarded a light command.

Cant. R. to V, 14 והיו נִגְלָלִין they could be folded up. Snh. 68 a my two arms which are like two scrolls of the Law שנגללין rolled up (not unfolded, i.e. with me learning is buried which I was prevented from teaching).—Trnsf., with על, to be rolled on top of, to prevail. Ber. 7 a יִגּוֹלּוּ רחמי על וכ' may my mercy prevail over my attributes (of justice &c.). Ib. יגולו רחמיך; v. גִּלְגֵּל.
Taan. 21 b; Men. 95 a הוּגְלְלוּ הפרוכות when the curtains (of the Tabernacle) were folded up (for removing).
—Part. pass. גְּלִיל unfolded, visible. Targ. Cant. V, 14.
Targ. Y. II Gen. XXVIII, 10 (some ed. לִגְלָלָא Pe.).
, v. גַּלְגֵּל, Ithpalp.

definicoes_originais: something rolled, rounded, ball, ordure, excrement, dung.
(with כְּלֵי) a material used for vessels, supposed to be baked ordure.
notas_originais: Men. 15 a; Pes. 13 b לחם ג' תודה the bread is an appendage of the thank-offering; Men. 80 a לִגְלַל תודה.—בִּגְלַל in consequence of, on account of, v. next w.

B. Kam. III, 3 ההופך את הג' he who upturns (throws up) ordure into the street.— Pl. גְּלָלִים, גְּלָלִין. Sabb. 153 b להטיל ג' to cast excrements (of animals). Lev. R. s. 16; Esth. R. to III, 1 מה הג' הללו וכ' as the dung is repulsive.
Kel. X, 1. Par. V, 5. Mikv. IV, 1; Sabb. 16 b. Men. 69 ab; a. fr. [Rashi to Sabb. l. c. expl. ג' = שייש, marble, to Men. l. c. = צפיעי בקר.]

notas_originais: [Ezra V, 8.]—Ḥull. 63 a אתא ג' a stone fell (from on high); Yalk. Zech. 578 גלאלא. Gitt. 47 a Ar. (ed. גַּלְגַּלְתָּא). Ab. Zar. 22 b, v. דַּגָּלָא.
— Pl. גְּלָלֵי. Ḥull. 112 a bot. תרי ג' דמלחא Rashi (ed. ג' מלחא) two lumps of salt.
— Pl. as supra. B. Kam. 92 b (prov.) a dog in his hunger ג' מבלע (Ms. H. sing.) will swallow excrements (Rashi: stones).
Targ. Ps. XL, 12 (Ms. ג' היכנא). Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 25; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: enrolar, desformar.; (denominação de גּוֹלֶם) calcular de uma só vez, fixar um preço arbitrário, opp. דקדק para calcular exatamente.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of גּוֹלֶם) to calculate in a lump, fix an arbitrary price, opp. דקדק to calculate exactly.
notas_originais: Denom. גּוֹלֶם.

Sifra B’har, Par. 6, ch. IX; B. Kam. 113 b יכול יִגְלֹום עליו you might think, he (the redeemer of the Jewish slave in possession of a gentile) was permitted to force an arbitrary price upon him (the gentile); [Rashi: (גלם to double) he (the gentile owner) might be permitted to ask an exorbitant price].—Part. pass. גָּלוּם, f. גְּלוּמָה 1) wrapt up. Sot. 42 a, v. גַּלְמוּד.—2) roughly shaped, unfinished. Pl. גְּלוּמִים, גְּלוּמוֹת. Sifré Num. 158, v. גּוֹלֶם. Ex. R. s. 30 מצות גלומות rough laws (containing no details, assigning no reasons; Var. lect. גולמות, גּוֹלָמִיּוֹת, fr. גּוֹלָמִי).
Denom. גְּלִים, גְּלִימָא I, גּוּלְמָא.
Denom. גְּלִימָא II.
, v. גְּלִים
, v. גּוֹל'
, v. גְּלִימָא II

, v. Fürst H. Dict. s. v.) like a shapeless, lifeless lump, whence (cmp. דמם) lonely, melancholy. Sot. 42 a in the sea-towns קורין לנידה ג' they call the menstruous woman galmudah ; R. Hash. 26 a. Ib. (phonetic etymol.) גמולה (דא) מבעלה she is weaned (separated) from her husband; [Ar. ed. Pes. a. Ven. גלומה, which version, however, disagrees with the reference to Gen. XXI, 8 in Ar. s. v.]. Gen. R. s. 31; s. 34 (ref. to Job XXX, 3) when there is want in the world &c. ג' הוי רואה … כאילו ג' be lonely; look upon thy wife, as if she were menstruous; Y. Taan. I, end, 64 d עשה אשתך ג' make thy wife lonely. [Cmp. Snh. 22 b, quot. s. v. גּוֹלֶם.]
Gen. R. s. 79, end they heard a woman say to her friend ג' אנא I am galmuda (for נדה), from which they learned the meaning of galmudah in Is. XLIX, 21 (v. corr. vers. in ‘Rashi’ a. l.).
, v. גַּלְמוּד

verbetes.glosa_atual: riscar, esfregar; estava aberto.; ser aberto por fricção ou arranhão, sangrar.; (com ב de pessoa) diminuir, expor a ignorância de, atacar.; , Nithpa.
definicoes_originais: to scratch off, rub; lay open.
to be opened through rubbing or scratching, to bleed.
(with ב of person) to detract from, lay bare the ignorance of, attack.
to be scratched open, v. supra.
to be laid bare, be argued.
notas_originais: Nidd. VIII, 2 (58 b) והיא יכולה להִגָּלֵעַ וכ' (Bart. להתגלע) and it (the wound) may have been bruised so as to bleed.

Y. Yeb. VIII, end, 9 d משום שלא לגְרוֹעַ בו וכ' (did they send him off) in order not to see him exposed, or because he was not fit (to argue)? What is the difference? היה דרכו לגַלֵּע א"ת משום שלא לגלע בו וכ' It was his (Rabbi’s) habit to begin with vehement argument; now, if you were to say, ‘in order not to see him exposed’, his exposure was in his own hand (he being the attacking part) &c. Ib. מה היה לו לגַ' בו what could he have attacked (on that subject of androgynos)?
נִתְגַּלֵּעַ

Snh. 6 b; Y. ib. I, 18 b (ref. to Prov. XVII, 14) (עד שלא נתג') קודם שנתג' הריב נטוש before the case of litigation has been laid open (fully argued), you (the judge) may compromise it &c.; Tanḥ. Mishp. 6; Yalk. Prov. 956 נִתְגַּלֶּה, יִתְגַּלֶּה).
, v. גָּלַשׁ
, v. גַּרְעִין, גַּרְעִינָה.

notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 47; s. 53; s. 63 ג' לה הקב"ה וכ' the Lord shaped a womb for her.—Part. pass. גָּלוּף engraven. Tanḥ. Balak 14.— Pi. גִּלֵּף same. Pesik. Ăniya, p. 137 a מְגַלְּפִין בו shaping it; Pesik. R. s. 32 מפליגים (corr. acc.).

Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 11. Targ. Hag. II, 23; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: aparecer, aparecer.; trazer à luz, publicar.; (denominação de גֶּלֶשׁ calvície) para ser aquecido o suficiente para escaldar o cabelo ou as penas da pele de um animal.
definicoes_originais: to come in sight, to come forth.
to bring to light, to publish.
(denom. of גֶּלֶשׁ baldness) to be made hot enough for scalding the hair or feathers of an animal’s skin.
notas_originais: Cant. R. to IV, 1 (ref. to שגלשו מהר וכ' ib.) הר שגלשתן מתוכה עשיתיו גלעד לאו"ה (not … תי) the mountain (of trouble) out of which ye came in sight again (ye escaped), I (the Lord) made it a hill of witness (a warning) to the nations; אי זה זה ים סוף what is this? It is the Red Sea [which R. Joshua … translated into Chaldean: טורא דאתנהרתון מן גווה]; ib. to IV, 4 הר שג' … הר סיני I made your escape memorable to the nations, it is Mount Sinai (by the giving of the Law); ib. repeatedly (referring to various escapes from dangers).
Ib. to IV, 1 ומה הגלשה הִגְלַשְׁתִּי וכ' (Ar. ed. Koh. גלשה) and what publication (institution or law) have I (the Lord) brought to light out of that event?
Part. מוּגְלָשׁ, pl. מוּגְלָשִׁין seething water. Pes. 37 b (Rabad to Eduy. V, 2 quotes a version מַגְלוֹשִׁין scalding water, Ar. מֵי גְלָשִׁים, fr. גֶּלֶשׁ; Y. Ḥall. I, 58 a top חַמִּין).

definicoes_originais: ; to shine, be bald ; v. גְּלֹושׁ, גְּלֹושׁוּתָא &c.—Part.
notas_originais: pass. גְּלִישׁ = h. מוּגְלָשׁ (v. preced.) brought to scalding heat, boiling over. Koh. R. to VIII, 9, v. גִּיסָא III.
Pl. גְּלָשִׁים. מֵי גְ' scalding water, v. גָּלַשׁ Hof.

Cant. R. to IV, 1 (a gloss to גלש) a woman whose hair is thick עבדא לה ג' ג' parts it so as to show white lines; הדא מוצינא כההוא לפי טבאות הוא עבד ג' ג' (prob. to be read … בוצינא כד הוא) a young pumpkin, when it sprouts nicely, produces bright stripes.
, v. הַגְלָשָׁה
Targ. Cant. to IV, 1 (v. Cant. R. to ib. s. v. גָּלַשׁ). [Ar. reads גבשושיתא, but the phonetic interpretation refers to שגלשו of the Hebrew text.]
= גְּלוֹשׁוּתָא. Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 42 sq.
= גְּלֹושׁ. Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 41.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [junção,]; também, também.; o gam de partículas no texto bíblico.
definicoes_originais: the particle gam in the Bible text.
notas_originais: Snh. 108 b; Taan. 21 a ג' זו לטובה this, too, is for the best. איש גם זו, v. גִּמְזוֹ.

B. Kam. 94 a ג' לב"ה קשיא the gam (Deut. XXIII, 19) is unaccounted for according to Beth Hillel’s opinion; Tem. 30 b. Esth. R. to I, 9 (ref. to גם ib.) אין ג' אלא ריבוי gam intimates an amplification, a. e.— Pl. גַּמִּים, גַּמִּין Gen. R. s. 1; Y. Ber. IX, 14 b bot. אתין וג' ריבויין the eths and the gams intimate an extended qualification (by implication), v. אֵת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) junta, ângulo, esp. dois lados de um retângulo.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) joint, angle, esp. two sides of a rectangle.
notas_originais: Erub. 55 a כמין גם Ar. (ed. גאם) in the shape of a right angle. Zeb. 53 b גמא (Yalk. Lev. 441 גאם). Pes. 8 b שורה אחת כמין ג' one row of wine vessels, in the shape of &c., i.e. the front and the whole upper layer. Y. ib. I, 27 b bot. קולפו כמין גם.—Kel. XIV, 8 (מפתח) של גם שנשבר מתוך גומו a key whose bit is joined (opp. to של ארכובה of one piece) broken at its junction. [Sabb. 105 a על הגם Ar., ed. על הגַּס, q. v.]— Pl. גַּמִּים, גַּמִּין. Y. Pes. l. c. קולפו כמין שני ג' he takes off for examination two front and two upper layers, v. supra. Ib. if the vessels are arranged like steps קולפו ג' ג' he must examine by front and upper layers on each landing. B. Mets. 28 a מדת גַּמָּיו the combined measure of both dimensions of a piece of goods, square measure, opp. מדת ארכו ומדת רחבו the measure of each dimension specified.—Sabb. 103 b גַּמִּין, v. גי"מל.—[Commentators explain our w. = Greek Gamma, Γ, whence the Var. גַּמָּא.]

the shape of a Gamma, Γ, v. preced.
notas_originais: Shek. III, 2 אלפא ביתא ג' Ms. O. (ed. גמלא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.), גָּמָה, גָּמַע tomar um gole, gole; para saborear, sugar.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.), גָּמָה, גָּמַע to take a draught, quaff; to sip, suck up.
notas_originais: Y. Maas. Sh. II, beg. 53 b he melted fat וגְמָעוֹ and sipped it; Y. Yoma VIII, 45 a top וגְמָייוֹ. Sabb. XIV, 4 (111 a) לא יִגְמָא בהן וכ' Ar. (ed. יִגְמַע, or יגַמּ' Pi., v. infra) he must not quaff vinegar through his teeth. Y. Maasr. III, 50 d bot. כמה … לִגְמוֹת בכוס how large a portion of the cup one must quaff at a time. Y. Shebi. II, end, 34 b; Y. Ned. VII, beg. 40 b the leaves of the colocasia must not be used (in case of a vow of abstinence from vegetables, or in the Sabbath year) לגמות וכ' to sip water out of them (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Colocasia); a. fr.
same. Sabb. 111 a מְגַמֵּעַ ופולט תנן (Ms. M. לא יִגְמַע ויפלוט) the Mishnah means, he must not quaff and spit out; Bets. 18 b; Y. Shebi. VIII, 38 a top מְגַמֵּא; a. fr.
Esth. R. to I, 9 (play on גם ib.) מיני ג' various delicacies.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pilp. de גמם) [ descascar, raspar; trnsf., cmp. חֲסַם II, חָכַךְ] hesitar, gaguejar, falar com uma expressão de incerteza ou de escrúpulo.
definicoes_originais: (Pilp. of גמם) [ to peel, scrape; trnsf., cmp. חֲסַם II, חָכַךְ] to hesitate, stammer, to speak with an expression of uncertainty or of scruple.
notas_originais: Kidd. 30 a אל תְּגַמְגֵּם ותאמר לו that thou need not hesitate in answering him; Sifré Deut. 34. Ber. 22 a היה מְגַמְגֵּם למעלה וכ' (Ms. M. a. Rashi מג' וקורא) was speaking hesitatingly over (as the Amora of) R. Judah &c. Ib. b מג' וקורא he should read in a hesitating manner (rapidly murmuring); Y. ib. III, 6 c bot. התחיל מג' בה he commenced stammering over it (hesitating to pronounce the Divine Name). [Cant. R. to VII, 1 מתגמגם, transpos. of מתמגמג, v. מָגַג.]
Ḥag. 15 b מְגַמְגֵּם בלישניה a stotterer (Ar. מלגס). Meg. 31 b קא מג' וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. Var. Lect.) read the curses (v. אֲרַר) rapidly murmuring; Koh. R. to VIII, 3.
, v. גּוֹמֶד
אמה גְמוּדָה a reduced cubit, v. גָּדם.— Pi. גִּמֵּד, v. גּוֹמֶד.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. קמט, קמץ) contrair, encolher, ficar apertado.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. קמט, קמץ) to contract, shrink, be tight.
notas_originais: Pes. 111 a גְּמוּד מסאניה (Ms. M. גמד) his shoes shrank (became too tight). Ḥull. 43 a גמדא ליה (the gullet) contracts. Gitt. 57 a גמדא the land shrinks, opp. רווחא. Yoma 69 a; Bets. 15 a האי נמטא גמדא דנרש וכ' the shrunk (hard) mattress of Narash (which does not warm) is permitted (does not come under the law of כִּלְאַיִם).—Part. pass. גְּמִיד contracted, atrophied. Targ. Jud. III, 15; XX, 16 (h. text אִטֵּר q. v.).
, v. preced.
pr. n. m. B. Kam. 72 a Rab. G.—Pes. 64 a; 73 b; Ḥull. 30 a R. Ḥiya bar G.
G., name of a river or canal in Babylonia. Ab. Zar. 39 a; Succ. 18 a נהר ג'.

VII, 9 ואין משלמין מהן ג' and favors received must not be repaid with them (the fruits of the Sabbath year); ib. Peah IV, 16.—גְּמוּלֹות. Deut. R. s. 1 ג' אני פורע (some ed. גמי' incorr.) I repay according to deeds.
— Pl. גְּמוּלָן. Targ. Ps. CXVI, 12.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גמס, para acasalar; cmp. גמז) canção de acoplamento, uma adaptação sarcástica de γάμος, para ridicularizar as canções hymeneanas em sua aplicação licenciosa à sodomia e à cópula de animais (cmp. אִיפּוֹתּוֹרוֹס).
definicoes_originais: (גמס, to couple; cmp. גמז) coupling song, a sarcastic adaptation of γάμος, to deride the hymenean songs in their licentious application to sodomy and to copulation of animals (cmp. אִיפּוֹתּוֹרוֹס).
notas_originais: — Pl. גְּמוּמָסִיֹּות, גּוּמָּסִיֹּות (Ar. ed. Koh. גַּמְסָסִיֹּות). Gen. R. s. 26 the generation of the flood were not doomed to destruction עד שכתבו ג' לזכר ולבהמה until they composed hymenean songs for sodomy &c.; Tanḥ., ed. Bub., B’resh. 22 גמיקיסום; 33 קמיסמסין, Var. קמיסקסין, Y’lamd. quot. in Ar. גמיסיקין—(perversions arisen from confounding our w. with גַּמִּיקִין q. v.); Yalk. Gen. 43 גממטיות (corr. acc.).; Lev. R. s. 23 גומסיות לזכר ולנקבה (corr. acc.).
or נמ', Koh. R. to III, 9, a corruption of אִנְבּוּרְקְרִין = אִנְבּוּרְקְרָאוֹת, v. אִמְבּוּרְקְלֹון

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. גמומסית), Pi. גִּמֵּז para casal, esp. suspender ramos do figo silvestre no cultivado (processo denominado caprificação, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Caprificatio).
definicoes_originais: (cmp. גמומסית), Pi. גִּמֵּז to couple, esp. to suspend branches of the wild fig on the cultivated (the process called caprification, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Caprificatio).
notas_originais: Tosef. Shebi. I, 11 ומצדדין ומְגַמְּזִין ed. (missing in ed. Zuck.).
Lam. R. to I, 15 (Ar. s. v. סח 3: בורגיא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (n. h.) pr. n. por favor. Gimzo, na Judéia.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. pl. Gimzo, in Judea.
notas_originais: Taan. 21 a, a. fr. נחום איש גם זו; Tosef. Shebu. I, 7 מנחם וכ' (always in two words).

definicoes_originais: (v. גמז) a fig or carob ripened through caprification.
notas_originais: Lam. R. to I, 5 (Ar. גמזין).

notas_originais: Y. Maas. Sh. II, beg. 53 b; Y. Yoma VIII, 45 a top גומנני; Y. Shebu. III, 34 b bot. גמרייה (corr. acc. or גַּמְזַיָּיה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גמז); ramos usados ​​para caprificação.; frutos amadurecidos por caprificação, v. גַּמְזוּז.

Y. בג', Var. מתזירין) they considered as permitted the use of branches of (carob or sycamore) trees belonging to the Temple treasury; Tosef. ib. III, 19 (Var. גזוזיות, גיזות); Men. 71 a ג' … של חרוב וכ'; Pes. 56 a; Y. ib. IV, 31 b; Y. Peah VII, end, 20 c. [R. Hai Gaon reads גַּוָּאזִיּוֹת twigs, cmp. גזוזיות Var. Tosef., v. supra.]
Tosef. Ter. V, 7.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pa. גַּמֵּי, גַּמַּע cap. = h. גָּמָא, גָּמַע, engolir, beber.
definicoes_originais: , Pa. גַּמֵּי, גַּמַּע ch. = h. גָּמָא, גָּמַע, to swallow, quaff.
notas_originais: Targ. Job XXXIX, 30 גָּמְעָן (Ms. גַּמְעַאן).—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 c bot. (expl. שורפה, Mish. II, 7) גמי לה (ed. גמילה, corr. acc.) he quaffs it, sucks it out. Succ. 49 b לִיגְמַע גַּמּוּעֵי let him quaff (take full draughts); ib. אגמע גמועי (read: מְגַמַּע with Rashi, or גַּמַּע, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300). Sabb. 109 b וליגמע.
Kil. VI, 9. Sabb. VIII, 2. Y. Erub. I, 18 d וגמי על גביהן and a reed-rope over them; a. fr.—Chald. form גָּמְיָיא. Ib.

Sabb. VIII, 1 (76 b) כדי גמיא' Ms. O. a. Ar. (ed. גמיע') as much as is quaffed at a time. Ib. 77 a (discussion about spelling with א or ע); Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 8 (with ע); Y. ib. VIII, beg. 11 a גמייה. Gen. R. s. 60 גמיי' אחת (some ed. גְּמִיָּה) only one quaff; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 13 כדי גמיא'; Num. R. s. 21 גמייא (corr. acc.); Midr. Prov. ch. XIII גמיאה.—Num. R. l. c. הוא עושה גמיע' אחת the Leviathan swallows with one quaff; Pesik. R. s. 16 (with א); a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גמל), ג' חֲסָדִים (também גְּמִילַת, v. גְּמִילָה) atos de amor, caridade (abr. ג"ח).
definicoes_originais: (גמל), ג' חֲסָדִים (also גְּמִילַת, v. גְּמִילָה) deeds of love, charity (abbr. ג"ח).
notas_originais: Peah I, 1. Ber. 5 a. Sot. 14 a the Torah תחילתה ג"ח וכ' begins with charity (clothing the naked, Gen. III, 2
and ends with charity (burying the dead, Deut. XXXIV, 6); a. v. fr.—[Deut. R. s. 1, v. גְּמוּל.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: (γαμικά, τὰ) casamento, festa nupcial (cujos convidados são as testemunhas do casamento; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Casamento); contrato de casamento.
definicoes_originais: (γαμικά, τὰ) marriage, nuptial feast (the guests of which are the witnesses of the marriage; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Marriage) ; wedding contract.
notas_originais: Pesik. Haḥod. p. 52 b; Yalk. Ex. 190 a king married many wives ולא כתב להם לא ג' ולא איפטיא but did not order in their behalf a record of the nuptial act or of the date of marriage וכיון שנשא … וכתב לה ג' וכ' but when he married a woman of noble descent, he had her marriage recorded as we read (Esth. II, 16) &c., v. אִיפַּטְיָא; Pesik. R. s. 15 כתובת גהיקן (read גמ'). Ex. R. s. 32 שאין ביניהם גמיסקין for there is between them no wedding feast to testify to their alliance. Ib. s. 47 כתב לה גמיסקוס משלו he had a marriage contract written at his own expense; עֲשֵׂה לה ג' ולואי וכ' prepare thou the certificate, and would I could prevail upon myself to lend my signature to it! [Var. in ed. a. Ar. גמיקן, גמיקון, גמיסקין, גמיסקוס, v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. גמס, note.—The nouns γαμισκος, γαμισκα, as if from γαμίσκω, are not otherwise recorded in the Greek vocabulary, and seem to be cacophemistic perversions; cmp. גמומסית.]
, v. גְּמוּמָסִית

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Parte. passagem de גְּמַר); (= h. כָּלִיל) acabado, perfeito.; holocausto, totalmente queimado.; (= h. כָּלָה) גְּמִירָא f. (com ou sem כלייה) destruição total, extermínio.
definicoes_originais: (= h. כָּלָה) גְּמִירָא f. (with or without כלייה) entire destruction, extermination.
notas_originais: . Targ. Ez. XVI, 14.

Targ. Gen. XVIII, 21 (Targ. Y. II, v. כְּלָיָיה). Targ. Jer. V, 18; a. fr.
Targ. I Sam. XX, 33; a. e.—V. also גְּמַר II, III.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) [amarrar, acoplar, carregar,]; carregar (bem ou mal), lidar, especialmente; para compensar, retribuir.; (cmp. גָּמַר a. חֲסַל) [para terminar,] desmamar.
definicoes_originais: to load ( good or evil) on, to deal with, esp .
(cmp. גָּמַר a. חֲסַל) [ to finish,] to wean.
notas_originais: to do good to. Gen. R. s. 38 שהוא ג' עליך תחלה for he was the first to do thee good; Yalk. Prov. 956.—Sabb. 104 a גְּמוֹל דלים, v. גימ"ל.—ג' חסד to be kind, charitable. Ib. שכן דרכו של גּוֹמֵל חסדים וכ' (Ms. M. דרכן של גּוֹמְלֵי) for such is the habit of the charitable to run after the poor. Yeb. 79 a; a. v. fr.

Dem. IV, 6 אע"פ שהן כגוֹמְלִין זה את זה although it has the appearance as if they were repaying each other (by mutual recommendations). Ab. Zar. 61 b חיישינן לגומלין we reject witnesses suspected of favoring each other; Keth. 24 a

B. Mets. 87 a on that day שג' אברהם וכ' when Abraham celebrated the weaning of Isaac &c.; Yalk. Gen. 93; Deut. R. s. 1 שמל (corr. acc.). Pesik. R. s. 25 תינוק הגָּמוּל וכ' a Jewish infant just weaned; a. fr.
Par. XI, 7 yon’koth are גבעולין שלא גָמְלוּ capsules of hyssop which are not yet developed; (Tosef. ib. XI (X), 7 גָּמְרוּ).
Gen. R. s. 53 נ' מחלבו weaned from his mother’s milk; ג' מיה"ר weaned from the evil inclination (able to resist temptation); a. fr.
—Y. M. Kat. III, 82 b bot. פרה מְגַמֶּלֶת a cow engaged for working in a team in turns; v. גַּמְלָא I, 2.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , para fazer o bem ou o mal.; estar carregado; para ser concedido.
definicoes_originais: , to do one good or evil.
to be laden with; to be bestowed.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. XXIV, 18; a. fr.—Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d bot. the whole town stopped work מִיגְמוֹל ליה חסד in order to show kindness to him (to give him an honorable funeral).—Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 c top גָּמֵיל חיסדא the charitable.
Targ. II Esth. V, 2 (Targ. I אטעינת, h. text וַתִּשָּׂא).—Y. Ḥag. l. c. לא איתג' ליה חסד nobody cared to attend his funeral, v. supra.
Bekh. 8 a. Ber. 56 b; a. fr.— Pl. גְּמַלִּים. Keth. 67 a ג' של ערביא וכ' camels in Arabia can be levied for a wife’s portion (כְּתוּבָּה); a. fr.

Kidd. IV, 13 one must not rear his son to be חמר ג' וכ' an ass-driver, or a camel-driver &c.; Y. ib. IV, end, 66 c; a. e.— Pl. גַּמָּלִין. Ib.—Y. M. Kat. III, 62 a bot. גַּמָּלָיו his drivers.—חַמָּר (וְ)גַמָּל ass-driver and camel-driver in one person (the camel-driver walking by the head of his beast, the ass-driver behind), one walking forward and backward, i.e. one who, owing to the loss of the object with which he appointed the central point for the movements of the day (v. עֵירוּב), may walk only from his home to that spot and back. Erub. III, 4 (35 a); Tosef. ib. V (IV), 2; Y. ib. III, 21 b top.
Targ. Is. III, 11. Targ. Ps. XCIV, 2. Ib. CXXXVII, 8 גַּמְ' Ms.; a. e.— Pl. גַּמְלַיָּא. Targ. Is. XXXV, 4.—Lev. R. s. 4 גַּמְלַיי טבייה דגמלית עימיך my benefits which I bestowed on thee.

verbetes.glosa_atual: c., cap.; = h. גָּמָל camelo.; casal, arranjo de equipe.; uma pequena ponte, cruzeta (cmp. גֶּשֶׁר).
notas_originais: Targ. Lev. XI, 4; a. e.—Snh. 106 a (prov.) ג' אזלא וכ' the camel went to ask for horns, and had her ears cut off.—Macc. 5 a ג' פרחא a flying (swift) camel, dromedary; Yeb. 116 a.—Ib. 45 a (prov.) ג' במדי וכ' in Media a camel can dance on a kab (bushel), i.e. in Media everything is possible. Sot. 13 b; Keth. 67 a, a. e. (prov.) לפום ג' שיחנא according to the camel is his load, i.e. the greater the man, the greater his responsibility.— Pl. גַּמְלִין, גַּמְלַיָּא, גַּמְלֵי. Targ. Gen. XXIV, 10 sq.; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 38.—Y. Hor. III, 48 a bot. אבא יודן דגַמְלוֹי Abba Yudan who is busy among his camels; Lev. R. s. 5 דגמלי; a. fr.

M. Kat. 11 b הוה להו ג' דתורא בהדי הדדי (Asheri 33 … עבוד גִּימְלָא) had an arrangement between them to team their oxen for mutual work. Ib. פסקיה לגַמְלֵיה he broke the arrangement (Ms. M.; as corrected, לגמלא ולא שדריה …, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); v. גָּמַל Pi.
M. Kat. 6 b והוא דליכא גשרא … ג' provided there is neither bridge nor crossboard. Snh. 67 b, v. אוּסְקָנִיתָא. B. Bath. 21 a ג' contrad. fr. תיתורא. Snh. 7 a, v. גּוּדָא.
Arakh. IX, 6. Tosef. Macc. III (II), 2; Y. ib. II, 31 d גַּמְלָה.
